top_signals.title: Fifa told Spain will pull out of hosting 2030 World Cup if Morocco hosts final
top_signals.summary: Spain will withdraw as a co-host of the 2030 World Cup if it is not awarded the final, the country’s likely next prime minister, Alberto Nunez Feijoo, has warned.  The issue has placed a strain on relations between Spanish football chiefs and Fifa, amid suspicions that Morocco will be given the honour of staging the [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
